scope: Franklin D. Roosevelt’s Little White House in Warm Springs, Georgia, as photographed in October 2016, with the attached curved sun deck corroborated by a March 2017 photograph.

originalReview.notes: The straight-on photograph records the four columns, porch pediment, cream-painted clapboard, four shuttered windows, French doors and pale grey-brown roof with an offset chimney.
The west terrace photograph shows the segmented curved white cutout rail, round sun deck and dark-green scalloped awning supported by narrow posts.

quallaSearch.notes: Both exact Qualla files match the photographer’s original uploads and first-party CC0 declarations. The front photograph supplies the appearance date; the close terrace photo corroborates the west deck within the same preservation era.
